messages:
jamie: Heads-up — planning a canary for model v3.2 tomorrow AM. Want to lock down percent + region toggles and the kill/fallback guardrails. Who's owning the flag and the schedule?
sana: I can own the flag. Proposal: roll by percent + region. Start 1% global + us-west-only for first 2 hours, then 5% global, then 20% just EU+NA, then 50% if stable.
mike: +1 on gradual ramp. Add an internal-only audience (redwood-internal) at 0.5% before public 1% so SRE & support can poke.
taylor: For the kill switch — make sure the feature flag supports immediate off (no deploy required) and fallback to model v3.1. Use flag key: `model.v3.2.canary` and fallback param `fallback_model: v3.1`. Also set a hard SLA-based breaker: if p50 latency > 400ms or error_rate > 0.5% for 10m, auto-disable.
olivia: Where do we wire the SLA alerts? Console will have dashboards but put an oncall alert in PagerDuty for the canary policy. I can add the composite alert: canary_latency_breaker and canary_error_breaker.
jamie: Good. Sana, can you paste the exact LaunchDarkly (or ff-service) rule JSON here so infra can validate? Also add a short rollout window (48h) and an explicit rollback checklist.
sana: Putting the flag rule here — this is a minimal rule set we'll push to ff-service:

```json
{
  "key": "model.v3.2.canary",
  "rules": [
    { "audience": "redwood-internal", "percent": 0.5, "regions": ["us-west"] },
    { "percent": 1, "regions": ["us-west"] },
    { "percent": 5, "regions": ["global"] },
    { "percent": 20, "regions": ["us-east","eu-west"] },
    { "percent": 50, "regions": ["global"] }
  ],
  "fallback": "v3.1",
  "ttl_hours": 48
}
```

mike: Looks good. Two quick asks: ensure traffic splitting is deterministic by user-id so we don't flip flakily for the same user; and add header override `x-model-override: v3.2-canary` for downstream tracing/logs.
luis: I'll update routing and add the header in the proxy (nginx/istio rule). Also add a trace tag `canary_v3_2=true` to sentry/span events.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] flag `model.v3.2.canary` created by sana at 1763501180. Rule validation: passed.
jamie: Nice. Olivia — once you add PagerDuty rules, can you also add a short runbook snippet in the console runbooks section: steps to toggle flag off, how to check fallback model, and how to re-run the canary after root cause fix?
olivia: On it. I'll draft the runbook and link it under the canary checklist. ETA 2h.
sana: I'll schedule the flag push to happen 10:00 PST tomorrow. Ramp tasks: manual step between 1% and 5% (2h wait + check metrics), automated between 5%->20% (if no breakers), and manual before 50%.
taylor: Also add a cost guard: if token-rate increase > 3x and cost delta exceeds threshold, pause ramp and notify finance-runbook.
jamie: Good call. One last thing — include a short note in #support Slack pinned to the thread so CS knows how to force users back to v3.1 if they see problems.
mike: I'll ping CS with a tiny KB and the override header + instructions.
jamie: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in the morning if anything changes. :thumbsup:
